title: AI PACs Spend Millions in 2026 Midterms with Mixed Results
excerpt: Political action committees backed by the AI industry spent millions on the 2026 midterms to influence Congress.
body_html:
Political action committees tied to the artificial intelligence sector invested millions of dollars into the 2026 midterm elections in an effort to impact the composition of Congress. According to reports, these expenditures yielded mixed outcomes for the industry's political groups.

Following the conclusion of these races, political organizations are already shifting their focus toward the next upcoming election cycle as efforts to shape future policy continue.
